decision.summary: Two candidate temporary offsets in allowed context [560,670]: (1) a multi-axis perturbation near index 575 with partial recovery but no full return; (2) a large asynchronous step starting at ~596 affecting all axes, with stable post-step levels but no observed reversal before index 670. Neither interval shows a confirmed return; both classified as uncertain.

intervals.observation: N shows a small positive shift (~+1.5 MAD) at ~575, E drops sharply (~−3 MAD), U rises (~+1.7 MAD); all three axes recover partially by ~578 but do not return to pre-event levels within allowed context. Return is incomplete and ambiguous; status uncertain.

N drops sharply (~−12 MAD) at ~596, E rises (~+12 MAD) with delay (~600–605), U drops (~−9 MAD) and stabilizes near new level by ~605. All axes remain offset through 634 with no observed return; sustained interior clear, but return unobserved in allowed context. Status uncertain.
